svg.title: The 45-minute system design interview, in six moves
svg.desc: Six step system design interview framework: clarify requirements for five minutes, estimate scale for five minutes, define the API for five minutes, draw the high level design for ten minutes, deep dive into one or two components for fifteen minutes, and discuss bottlenecks and trade-offs for five minutes.
